dina (finance): AureliaMeter quote review. Their price sheet mixes per-token, per-call telemetry, and a 'stream-charge'. Before I sign off, can procurement/eng list the exact clarifications we need?
harry (procurement): On the quote I spotted both TELEMETRY and REQ lines. Need canonical mapping to our buckets: sync generation, streaming chat, and embeddings batch. Also confirm net terms and dispute window.
meera (eng-ml): Their docs say 'stream-charge applies per active websocket segment' — unclear if that's additive to per-token. Request worked examples with math for three scenarios.
dina (finance): Redacted SKU excerpt: 
```
SKU,Unit,Price,Notes
AM-TOKEN,token,0.00049,per-token
AM-EMB,embedding,0.00195,per-embedding-unit
AM-TELEM,event,0.00003,ingress/telemetry event
AM-STREAM,segment,0.006,per-stream-segment
AM-RESERVE,monthly,2200,reserved credits + discount
```
meera (eng-ml): Please ask them to show line-by-line invoice math for: (1) single completion 250 tokens out, (2) streaming chat 10 turns with streaming enabled (avg 55 tokens out), and (3) batch embeddings 200k units. For each case we need the exact CSV row that maps to each invoice line.
celine (legal): Contract asks: 30-day dispute window (their template is 7/10 days), clear audit right for usage logs, and clause that invoice disputes pause collections until resolved.
toby (security): Security questions: do telemetry logs include request/response bodies? retention defaults? option for redaction or KMS? Also where backups are stored (region).
harry (procurement): I'll consolidate: 1) canonical SKU mapping mapped to our three patterns, 2) three worked examples with math + sample invoice PDF, 3) raw export (CSV + BigQuery) with columns: request_id, utc_ts, model, token_in, token_out, embedding_units, session_id, sku_applied, cost_cents, 4) proration rules for mid-cycle reserved changes, 5) reserved credit rollover policy, 6) SOC2/SAML and data residency, 7) dispute terms = 30 days, 8) right to audit usage logs. Mark high: SKU mapping, raw export, sample invoice.
aureliameter-bot: AureliaMeter AE: "Thanks — we'll send canonical SKU mapping and the three worked examples with a sample invoice and CSV export. Streaming segment fee can be disabled for committed plans. We support SOC2, SAML, and KMS; log retention configurable (30/90/365). We'll clarify proration and rollover rules in follow-up"
celine (legal): Good. I'll draft the redline for audit/dispute once we have the invoice sample.
meera (eng-ml): I'll prepare the CSV schema snippet to paste in the reply so they can confirm column names.
dina (finance): Thanks — once Harry posts the consolidated questions I'll approve sending to the AE. :thumbsup:
